text:
Alex: Quick sync — we need to pick sequencing for the integration-onboarding initiative. Sales/BD are pushing for Console admin flows; engineering favors API-first. I sketched a couple RICE-ish numbers but want tradeoff inputs.
Kevin: API-first wins for iteration speed and observability. Smaller surface -> fewer regressions. Example quick RICE sketch: Reach=4, Impact=3, Confidence=70, Effort=3 => score ~2.8.
Anya: Design note: Console reduces support touch for enterprise customers (less hand-holding). But it multiplies UI surface and corner cases. We can design a minimal admin surface that covers 80% of the ask.
Sam: Infra implications: API endpoints autoscale straightforwardly. Console requires RBAC, SSO, audit logs, and extra metrics retention. That's ~2 infra sprints if we scope it full.
Lina: From sales: BigBank pilot explicitly requires a self-serve admin UI for model pinning + audit trail. They paused integration until they see an admin surface. They'll sign a PO if we can show an admin MVP in Q2.
Alex: OK — here's a proposed sequencing:
  1) Ship API-first core (integration webhooks, schema, model-pin API, simple SDK) — target = quick wins for devs, enables partners to build. Launch criteria: SDK examples + two integration tutorials, <100ms median for happy-path calls, e2e tests green.
 2) Console Admin MVP (read-only model pinning UI, user invites, audit log view) — gated behind Dedicated/private pilots; minimal workflows only. Launch criteria: SSO + audit table + 3 enterprise test signoffs.
 3) Console iteration (write flows, role management, bulk operations) after pilot feedback.
Kevin: +1 to that sequence. One concern: customers will hit the API but expect a Console to verify state. We should add a small "sync" CLI/web preview so early adopters can validate without full Console.
Anya: Agree. We can ship a lightweight Console 'preview' (single-page pinning view) that reads the API and is behind a feature flag. That reduces design and infra scope but satisfies Biz.
Lina: If we promise the preview by pilot kickoff, BigBank is happy to proceed. They only need visibility for audits, not full role management yet.
Sam: Technical risk: audit log retention + export for compliance. If preview is read-only, we can reuse API audit stream and add a simple pagination UI. Effort drops to ~1 infra sprint.
Alex: Decision proposition: API-first + feature-flagged Console preview for pilot (read-only pin + audit view) -> if pilot converts, roll out Console MVP with SSO/RBAC. RICE calc favors API-first but business value from pilot can justify a small preview sprint. Anyone object? :thinking:  
Kevin: No objection. Want the API contract locked before preview UI. I'll write the API spec PR today.
Anya: I'll prototype the single-page pin view and share mocks in #design by EOD.
Lina: I'll confirm BigBank timeline and push for a firm PO contingent on preview delivery.
Sam: I'll scope infra work and tag it as blocker for preview if audit streaming needs changes.
pm-bot: New action items created: #1234 (API spec PR), #1235 (preview UI mock), #1236 (infra audit scope).
Alex: Cool — we'll sync again Thurs. If anyone has alternate sequencing ideas (e.g., Console-first for enterprise), post here but include explicit RICE/effort numbers so we can compare objectively. :thumbsup:
